reviews.title: Great app, grew my sleep awareness
reviews.text: Love the app—would be cool if (1) it reported your sleep deficiency to calibrate where you’re at, (2) would love to see Core, Deep, and REM graphed over time to see if there’s trends impacting sleep quality over time, add RHR to trends, and finally (4) please include HRV and RHR in the csv export. 🙏

reviews.title: Readiness Score
reviews.text: Lately I wasn’t feeling bad on my readiness score. It was always in green. Lately for 15 days is been in the red( low score)! On apple app it’s been high or very high. I trusted Sleep++ along Apple app for sleep. It’s been inaccurate and can’t deal thinking I’m not well. So I deleted it!

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text: It used to work great. Then all of a sudden, the tracking changed and now I don’t get the same info. The app went backwards. Not worth looking at any more.

reviews.title: Useless without an Apple Watch
reviews.text: Just a place to manually journal that you’ve slept. Compared to Sleep As Android, this is truly an embarrassment

reviews.title: Not recognized in Apple Health
reviews.text: New iPhone 17, iOS ver. 26.5 This app doesn’t provide any sleep data.  That’s $1.99 down the toilet.

reviews.title: Used to work; doesn’t work reliably now
reviews.text: This used to reliably work but stopped accurately tracking my sleeps and cuts off half the night constantly. The FREE Health app Apple offers does this better than this guy’s development does. How did this app get crappier over time? 0-stars if I could. Uninstalling and wish I hadn’t bought the premium.

reviews.title: DON’T BOTHER!!
reviews.text:
I wrote to the developers several months ago regarding a problem where days of sleep of are combined. They said they would get back to me, which they did not. I followed up with another email, which went unanswered.  ZERO support.
UPDATE:  About a year later: Another unanswered email.  Going to find an app that actually works.

reviews.title: Bye bye Sandman
reviews.text: This app never ceases to wake my awareness of my general state of mind and body. I share it with my Meta AI everyday to get another opinion to help me focus on the data as it reveals not only comparative periods but general trends and long term trends. I have used it for over four years. Do not get upset if it tells you things you don’t want to believe. Play with the sleep length adjustments and learn from the variations that such adjustments make to the overall score. It helps guide you on possible approaches you have to your sleep cycle. There, was that long and boring enough to put you to sleep?

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: This program is a basic waste of time. If you use it with your watch, it will record what input is given. It does not work automatically and has to be started and stopped. That’s great if you remember to do that every single night of your life! However, if it needs to be edited or you miss a night and you want to manually correct, you can’t do anything with it. When you have it track your blood oxygen and heart rate during the night, it doesn’t work. You’re much better off finding another sleep app.

reviews.title: Always a day behind
reviews.text: 3 stars because this app has always been a day behind.   WHY???  It’s Thursday and it’s showing Wednesday.  WHY???  Can’t really track sleep if it’s a day behind!!  FIX THIS!!!

reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text: Yo, i wanted to say thank you to the developer for making such a simple yet useful app for free when others are horrific in comparison. I’m a student and just wanted to track my sleep but most apps I saw are locked behind ridiculous paywalls or just suck. So yeah this might be the best one out there. I see ppl complaining about the ads, but really? Do you care enough about sum 1 ad that you would not like this objectively perfect free sleep tracker. The dev isn’t even in the charge of it. They must have made a mistake or taken advantage of, this doesn’t take away ANYTHING. Again thank you devs actually made my last few weeks sleep better

reviews.title: What’s with the porn?
reviews.text: I have been using this app for awhile and been happy enough with it. In the past few weeks, though, I’m now getting porn add at the top of the display. That’s a no for me dawg.

reviews.title: Great but the ads?
reviews.text: It’s a great app for tracking sleep but the ads are awful. Pornographic ads with nudity in them is not acceptable to me. I deleted.

reviews.title: Sleep++ vs SleepMatic
reviews.text:
Effective 3/2026, I removed this app due to it having VULGAR sex photos on the first screen showing male and female body parts and sec toys.  That’s not what I signed up for. 

Decided to try this one. Not sure if I like it as well. On the few occasions that I take a nap, SleepMatic records the info whereas this one does not.

reviews.title: App is greats, Ads are purposefully deceivingly gross
reviews.text: The app works fine but I’m going to get rid of it due to the ads. They’re at the top of the page and purposefully meant to look sexual in nature. They’re tiny thumbnails and while not inappropriate upon inspection, they are MADE to look sexual and gross. I already reported it months ago but nothing has changed. I could never check this app with my child near, I feel gross opening it, absolutely disgusting.

reviews.title: Stopped working on new phone
reviews.text: I paid for it. Moved it to my new phone. Now it won’t record sleep properly. Waste of money.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Never syncs! My app is constantly a week behind in showing my sleep results no matter how much I reset it and ensure my BT connections to my watch! So disappointed in this app. And I actually paid for it - ugh! Don’t recommend it!

reviews.title: So far off it’s laughable
reviews.text: Not even close to being accurate. For the last two nights it’s had me getting 9 hours of sleep. I haven’t gotten 9 hours of sleep in 20 years. It also in the past 2 nights, it had me in bed sleeping at 1030 but I was up working both nights until 1am.  In addition, I have a new born baby. I’m lucky to get 5 hours of sleep let alone 9.

reviews.title: Has problems
reviews.text:
This app needs some design help. It looks like it hasn’t been touched since 2010. 

The ads have alway felt slimy and adds to the cheapness. But just now I got an add with barely clothed people accentuating … well endowed people. 

It might have useful data, but I just can’t.

reviews.title: RHR no longer recording on iOS 18
reviews.text: Great app overall but there is a bug with RHR no longer being read despite having access. Would love if the developer paid more attention to this app or would sell it to someone who would.

reviews.title: Loved this but not so much now
reviews.text: I have been using this app for a long time and haven’t had many issues. But ever since the last iOS update the auto tracking of sleep no longer works. I have to manually record it every day and even then it doesn’t fully capture all the information that it used to. I’ve tried to communicate with Support, but I’ve had no response or success in communicating with them.

reviews.title: Cannot Cancel!
reviews.text:
App by passing the App Store and using my credit card suddenly again. App recorded 54 hours in a 24 hour period. They will keep your credit card info and charge. I can't cancel via Apple Subscriptions and  have no idea how
Many more charges to expect. I'm bed bound due to fractures so it just keeps showing me as asleep 24/7 although it is calculating more than 24. Beware!

reviews.title: Frustrating if you sleep ofd hours
reviews.text: I like seeing the Deep, Core, Rem, & Awake stages. However, it doesn’t track 24 hours, so if I don’t awaken until 10AM, it doesn’t record the last hour or two. What I see on my watch doesn’t always transfer to the phone app. Also I wish the phone app’s sleep analysis listed the total minutes asleep on top rather than the total time analyzed.

reviews.title: Inconsistent at best
reviews.text: It’s used to be a very accurate sleep tracker however now at least half the time it seems unable to actually measure the sleep stages. I would definitely only use this as a secondary sleep tracker.

reviews.title: Incredibly inaccurate
reviews.text:
In the past, I’ve found this app to be incredibly inaccurate. I’ve decided to give it another look and to compare Sleep++ against both my WHOOP and Apple Watch to see if accuracy has improved. I’ll be conducting this test for the entire month of October.

Conclusion: Apple Watch (AW Ultra 3 in most recent testing) is far superior with regards to accuracy. Furthermor, Sleep++ adds to the sleep data Apple gathers, if you give it the ability to write date to Apple Health. 

If you care about accurate sleep tracking/sleep staging, avoid this app.

reviews.title: Was good no longer
reviews.text: This once was a good sleep tracking app but no longer. It will not let track my sleep because it wants me to turn on motion tracking which is and all ways has been on not happy about losing an app I counted on for sleep tracking.

reviews.title: Inconsistent
reviews.text: It is amazing to me that the five different sleep apps I have all display different sleep data.  This is puzzling because all sleep apps get their data from the same source , the watch.  This brings up the question, "which is correct and accurate".  In my mind, this makes all the sleep apps useless.  Sorry, they aren’t scientifically significant, and it’s all PR.

reviews.title: Poorly documented
reviews.text: Interesting app, but not well documented. Tried to find out more about the "Readness" score. What do the abbriviations mean? How is it calculated? Couldn't find anything in the app or on their website.

Even worse than before. Constantly locks up, prevents editing sleep periods which is needed as it is hopeless at getting that right. A Mess!!

reviews.title: Hit or Miss
reviews.text: Started using this app well over a year ago.  I’d say it automatically tracked my sleep maybe 40% of the time.  The rest I would have to input myself.  Awake times fluctuate wildly - I would wake up during the night and watch tv for hours only to be told I was awake for 10 minutes.  Had high hopes for this app but will be looking for a new one.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: Used to be great, once I got my iPhone 16pro max it stopped working. All software is updated, all permissions are allowing, even went as far as purchasing the app. Still zero data being tracked. I want my money back.

reviews.title: Great tracking
reviews.text: Easy to use app that does it all. Tracks hours of sleep and sleep variability, including stages of sleep, heart rate, respiratory rate, and oxygen levels. Accurate to the minute on times awake during sleep. Gives you percent readiness score based on sleep quality measures. Can adjust sleep times if needed. Works perfectly with AppleWatch only if you set your watch to sleep to start the app. Been using it for 3 years.

reviews.title: No analysis beyond health app dats
reviews.text: The data shown is available in the health app. The only analysis by the app is a readiness score, but no deeper analysis provided except giving a score. Sleep temperature not provided. Why look at this app instead of the health app? App needs to help you interpret the data.
